title: Remove caffeine.ai branding and document custom/short domain guidance

requirements.summary: Remove all visible caffeine.ai watermark/branding from the UI (footer and any other user-facing text).
acceptanceCriteria: The AppShell footer no longer displays the text/link "caffeine.ai" and does not link to caffeine.ai.
No other user-facing UI text (header/footer/pages) contains "caffeine.ai" (case-insensitive).
The app continues to build and render normally after removing the branding.

file_operations.description: Remove the footer referral text/link and any other user-facing mentions of "caffeine.ai" from the AppShell layout while preserving overall footer layout and build stability.

requirements.summary: Remove hardcoded caffeine.ai URL usage and add English documentation describing custom/short domain setup at a high level without referencing caffeine.ai.
acceptanceCriteria: There are no hardcoded links to "https://caffeine.ai" in the frontend codebase.

Frontend docs/README include a short section describing that the deployed app URL is determined by the IC deployment/canister and that a shorter/custom domain requires external DNS/domain configuration steps (described at a high level) without mentioning caffeine.ai.
All new/updated user-facing documentation text is in English.

file_operations.description: Eliminate any hardcoded external branding URL usage pointing to caffeine.ai (including the dynamic referral URL construction) and replace with neutral/non-branded behavior (e.g., no external branding link).
Replace the example/comment text that includes "caffeineAdminToken" with neutral naming so the codebase avoids caffeine.ai-derived naming where practical, without changing runtime behavior.

Add an English documentation section explaining that the deployed site URL is determined by the IC canister deployment, and that using a shorter/custom domain requires external domain/DNS and IC boundary/gateway configuration steps at a high level (no caffeine.ai references).

Add a brief English note in deployment guidance reiterating that the canister URL is assigned by the IC deployment and that custom domains are configured externally via DNS and IC boundary/gateway routing (high-level only, no caffeine.ai references).
